title: Foundational Live Production Rigging
content_type: web presentation with narration and slide timings
database_target: future MySQL-backed RAG extraction for LMS

preservation_policy.exact_duplicate_rule: If two files have the same SHA-256 checksum, store one canonical file and represent the duplicate path/name as an alias or reference record. Do not keep redundant binary copies unless there is a documented reason.
preservation_policy.non_identical_rule: If checksums differ, keep both files even if filenames, formats, or apparent content are similar.
preservation_policy.dedupe_method: SHA-256 exact-match only; no fuzzy matching, perceptual image matching, audio similarity, or content rewriting unless explicitly approved later.

notes: The final LMS/RAG outflow is intentionally marked unconfirmed.
This folder should be treated as a staging content unit, not the final LMS schema.
Large binary files should be stored with Git LFS or object storage if connector upload limits block direct GitHub storage. The SHA-256 values above preserve identity for verification.
Identical duplicates should be removed only after checksum verification and replaced with alias/reference metadata so no source context is lost.
